subject: science
domain: Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions

items.prompt: Does a longer stopping time increase or decrease the force in a collision?

steps: Longer stopping time means less force.

items.prompt: Why does an airbag protect a person?
items.answer: It extends the stopping time, reducing the force

steps: Longer stopping time means less force on the person.

items.prompt: Why bend your knees when you land?
items.answer: To stop over a longer time and reduce the force

items.prompt: To reduce collision force, should a device increase or decrease stopping time?

steps: More stopping time means less force.

items.prompt: Name one safety device that reduces collision force.
Which protects a phone better: a padded case or a thin hard case?

steps: Padding extends stopping time, reducing force.

items.prompt: What does a crumple zone in a car do?
items.answer: Extends the stopping time to reduce force

items.prompt: Does a soft landing surface reduce or increase the force of a fall?

steps: Soft surfaces extend stopping time, reducing force.

items.prompt: The force in a collision is smaller when the stop happens over a ____ time.

steps: A longer stopping time means less force.

items.prompt: Name a playground feature that reduces injury from falls.
items.answer: A cushioned surface (rubber mats or wood chips)

items.prompt: Explain why an airbag reduces force better than a hard dashboard.
items.answer: It stops the person over a longer time, so the force is smaller

steps: Longer stopping time reduces the force.

items.prompt: Explain why a padded phone case protects a phone.
items.answer: It extends the stopping time when dropped, reducing the force

items.prompt: How does bending your knees when landing protect you?
items.answer: It lengthens your stopping time, lowering the force on your legs

items.prompt: Design a device to protect a dropped egg and explain how it works.
items.answer: Wrap it in padding to extend its stopping time and reduce the force

items.prompt: Why do all these safety devices work the same way?
items.answer: They all extend the stopping time to reduce the force
